claims.statement: Diagrams should match a design system through shared visual choices.
Current default colors resemble other tools and lack a deliberate identity.
Prioritize improvements and variation in node padding and color choices.
Propose five varied, professional initial themes.
Current Theme is light/dark; color swatches and node spacing use separate fixed values.
Padding must be shared by sizing and rendering to avoid text and geometry conflicts.
Use shared diagram tokens with five presets; recommend Graphite as the default.
Include an editorial theme with serif titles and deliberate type variation across themes.

The DSL file owns theme and style overrides. Agents and humans can override default colors, padding, radius, and supported typography directly; viewer, CLI, save/reopen, and exports use the saved values.
Extend available colors and support shades within a color family so authors can express emphasis or detail, including DSL declarations and node/group selection.
Use numeric shades instead of named emphasis levels, with 500 as the default. Proposed built-in stops are 50,100,200,300,400,500,600,700,800,900,950.
claims.notes: User explicitly selected numeric shades and suggested 500; complete stop list is the agent proposal. Lower numbers mean lighter colors; higher numbers mean darker colors.

shape.appetite: One diagram appearance model, five presets, source overrides, and a compact chooser; no editor redesign.
shape.problem: Fixed pastels and scattered spacing/type rules prevent a deliberate identity and simple design-system matching.
shape.recommended_shape: Five presets over shared resolved appearance; extensible named families with numeric shades 50–950, default 500, source-owned overrides, deterministic metrics, separate editor mode, and matching exports.
success_moves: Prove Fieldnotes end to end first because serif titles expose sizing differences.
Share deterministic wrapping and padding between compilation and rendering; use real browser bounds only to verify fit.
Keep appearance in source and JSON, outside camera and editor mode ViewState.
Use direct bounded source overrides before building a visual customization panel.
Include the independently implemented CLI SVG renderer in the first proof.
Use an owned local service and temporary fixture copies; no deployment or personal diagram edits.

history.change: Created planned initiative from the current request. Captured intent, compared collection approaches, and proposed five theme directions with a concept sheet. No application code changed.

Added explicit editorial serif/type requirement, revised and inspected concept sheet, completed shape and three-milestone implementation plan. No execution started. Prior font deferral is superseded. No downstream artifacts remain stale.
Promoted DSL ownership and direct default-style overrides to an explicit requirement. Updated intent, shape, and plan in place; all remain current. No implementation started.

Extended intent, shape, theme directions, and plan for additional named color families and emphasis shades. Replaced six-slot ceiling and adjusted theme switching to preserve custom definitions. All artifacts current; implementation remains planned.

Replaced proposed subtle/normal/strong variants with numeric shades, default 500. Built-in ramp proposes 50,100–900,950 in light-to-dark order. Updated intent, shape, plan, and theme directions; no semantic aliases or parallel scheme planned.

history.event: Implementation started in ~/Projects/diagram-studio (app worktree claude/diagram-themes-styles-6139de, based on 1e8c7f0). Plan reconciled: files are .draft and the CLI is `pnpm draftably`, not .meld/`pnpm meld`.

All three milestones implemented and proven. Decisions made during execution: group default shade is theme-dependent (100 light, 900 Midnight) so groups stay quiet surfaces; explicit size is now exact with a text-overflow warning (was: grows); teal/orange became real families (were aliases); default (no color) nodes use the theme's neutral surface. Gaps: standalone (non-file) diagrams do not resize existing nodes when theme metrics change; icon and image shapes keep their own sizing; main JS bundle grew ~120KB from inlined fonts; label placement can still clip a long connection label in a narrow gap (pre-existing).

color_model.built_in_families: Extend beyond current six; select additional families while reviewing complete palettes.
color_model.custom_families: Named in DSL; define fill, stroke, and ink for each referenced numeric shade. Custom families can define only the stops they use. Missing shade means 500.
color_model.inheritance: Auto color inherits family. Shade uses explicit object value or diagram default, independently.
color_model.theme_switch: Clear built-in overrides; keep custom definitions and object references.
color_model.generation: Curated variants; no automatic shade-generation system required.
color_model.ordering: Lower numbers are lighter; higher numbers are darker. Keep this direction in every theme, including Midnight.
